_comment: Generated from clean parent stress/flakiness series rows. A cell appears only when passed and diverged comparisons were both observed at the exact Hermit tree. sample_size counts compared outcomes only; no_result, timeout, errored, and skipped rows are excluded. sample_size does not state a failure rate: 29 observations with none of one outcome are needed for a 95% upper bound below 10%, and 59 for a bound below 5%.
